name: Black Pearl
description: Known as the Black Battleship, it is the protagonist's pirate ship in the movie "Pirates of the Caribbean" and is the fastest ship in the Caribbean. The whole ship has a reasonable structural design. The streamlined hull and huge power make it extremely fast. There are several cannons on the ship with powerful firepower. In the sea called the Caribbean, there is a black battleship, which makes all enemies aware of the biting frost. When Captain Jack and the Black Pearl merge, what is born is the domineering and unprecedented Black Pearl.
